promptText: The diagram below shows how electricity is generated in a hydroelectric power station. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

sourceCharts.title: Hydroelectric Power Station
sourceCharts.unit: Daytime electricity generation and nighttime pumping cycle
